review_scope_note: Unlike prior API-based reviews that saw only the finding text, this audit had full repository access: experiment kernels, archived run logs/CSVs, prior reviews, remediations, and paper/CERTIFICATE.md where applicable. Quantitative claims were checked against primary artifacts; arithmetic and hashes were recomputed where feasible. No computational result was invented.
verification_methods: Read cayley_gpu.cu for ambient group, stopping criterion, frontier clipping, encoding width
Checked for per-prime diameter logs / popcount certificates

claim_reviews.claim: Kernel uses det=-1 generators, stops when total_visited reaches |SL2(p)|, and can clip frontiers without popcount validation.
claim_reviews.evidence: Code inspection confirms these limitations; the finding's audit caveats are accurate and necessary.

claim_reviews.claim: uint32 element codes remain valid through p=1021.
claim_reviews.evidence: p^4 exceeds 2^32 for p≳251 (1021^4 ~ 1.09e12). Encoding width is insufficient for the claimed range.

claim_reviews.claim: Published numbers are certified Cayley diameters of SL2(F_p).
claim_reviews.evidence: Ambient-group mismatch + missing unique-visit certificates + possible clipping + encoding issue. Treat as exploratory short-word BFS depths only — which is what the revised title says.

claim_reviews.claim: Empirical diam(p) ≤ 2 log p style bound as a conjecture from the data.
claim_reviews.evidence: Reasonable as an empirical hypothesis if the BFS depths are recomputed under a corrected certificate; not presently a theorem.

missing_references: Corrected kernel in GL2/PGL2 or even-word SL2 with popcount certificates and wider codes
overall_assessment: The revised exploratory framing is the right scientific move. Manifest silver/gold recommendations for certified SL2 diameters were inflated. As exploratory BFS depth data with explicit caveats, bronze is fair; as certified diameters, the result is not ready.
recommendations: Fix encoding and ambient group before any Q0 pipeline use
Do not feed these diameters into effective-bound arguments until certified
certification_justification: Honest exploratory computation with serious methodological caveats already on the page. Silver would require a corrected certificate.
